title: ci(test-core): build declarations on one CLI slice only — pin the CLI's declaration readers into slice 1/n
body:
Part of #25870

Ruling-ref: 6439314592
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** CLI 测试里只有 5 个文件要读构建出的 `.d.ts`。现在 vitest 把它们固定排进第 1 片(sequencer 在 `packages/cli/vitest.config.ts`)。Test Core 只在带 cli 1/4 的那个分片构建声明,metadata 也被排到同一分片;其余分片都设 `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`。
- **为什么改:** 以前这 5 个文件按 sha1 散落在 4 个切片里,导致 5 个分片各自多花约 4.5 分钟构建声明。改后只剩 1 个分片构建声明。按模型推算,最慢分片从约 22 分钟降到约 19 分钟,CI 实际预计 20–21 分钟。
- **风险与回滚:** 另外 515 个 cli 文件里有 9 个换了切片,对负载敏感的邻居可能跟着变(#25968 那一类)。以后有人新增读声明的测试却没登记,它会在不构建声明的分片上以 TS7016 报红,失败是响亮的。回滚办法是 revert 本 PR,只涉及 3 个文件,不动数据也不动 schema。
- **先看:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 里 "Choose this shard's declaration build" 一步的 `case` 判断;`packages/cli/vitest.config.ts` 的 `DeclarationReaderSequencer.shard()`;`scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` 的 `partition()` / `refineToCap()` 对 `rideWith` 的处理。
- **两分钟验证:** 运行 `node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`,应看到 `self-test OK` 和 `whole legs 143/1597/1597/925/924/923/1599/1597s`,其中第 1 分片只放 cli 1/4 和 metadata。
- **需要你做的:** 以 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 身份审阅并批准这个 Tier H PR(`.github/workflows/ci.yml`)。

## What changes

Ruling A (6439314592), as specified in 6436991767, built on seat 1's commit `7e64f7c1d3` (cherry-picked onto current `main`, every hunk re-read and re-verified here) plus one fix:

- **`packages/cli/vitest.config.ts`.** `DECLARATION_READER_FILES` lists the 5 files that compile against built declarations. `DeclarationReaderSequencer` overrides only `shard()`. It puts the readers first and the remaining files in vitest's own sha1 order (key `/` + root-relative path, the same as `BaseSequencer`), then cuts that sequence with vitest's own equal-count ranges. The readers land in slice 1/n, and every other file moves at most 5 places along vitest's order. The config refuses to load when a listed reader is missing from the queue population. It also refuses when the readers do not fit in slice 1/n. With no shard set, or in a nightly-tier run (no readers in the population), the order is vitest's own.
- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`**, the Test Core "Choose this shard's declaration build" step and its comment only. `DTS_READER_SLICE='1'`: a shard keeps declarations when it carries a whole reader package or slice `1/*` of one. Every other shard sets `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`. The comment now lists `create-in-repo-scaffold-typechecks`, which the earlier list missed.
- **`scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs`.**
  - The reader slice is charged the declaration closure as packing weight: 270 s × 2.9 = 783 s. This is never test weight, so the slice-count derivation, the drift step and `serialFloorOf()` are unchanged.
  - Every whole package in `DECLARATION_READER_PACKAGES` (`@objectstack/metadata`) rides into the reader slice's bin, so one shard builds declarations, not two.
  - A run with no reader slice (cli whole, cli absent, or a nightly document) is charged nothing and splits exactly as before.
  - The self-test reads the slice index back from all three places it is spelled (ci.yml, the cli config, this map). Battery 3e: 16 checks.
- **Fix on top of the inherited commit:** `refineToCap()` could move the riding whole reader off the reader slice's shard. That would put declarations back on a second shard. Riders are now fixed in place like slices. The self-test gains the fixture where only that rule keeps the rider in place.

⛔ Unchanged: no test is skipped or quarantined, no timeout is raised, no test leaves Test Core, the shard count stays 8, and no other `ci.yml` job is touched.

## Tests

All readings are local, on a shared 4-core box, so wall-clock figures are shared-box seconds.

<details><summary>Reader set re-derived on current main (merge base 912076f885)</summary>

- `OS_SKIP_DTS=1 turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/cli --filter=@objectstack/metadata`: 61/61 tasks, and 0 `.d.ts` files under `packages/spec/dist` and `packages/cli/dist`.
- The whole cli suite on that closure (`vitest run --maxWorkers=3`, under the verify lock) gave `VERDICT command-exit 1`, with `Test Files 5 failed | 514 passed | 1 skipped (520)` and `Tests 25 failed | 6432 passed | 9 skipped (6466)`. The red files are exactly the 5 listed in `DECLARATION_READER_FILES`, and every one fails for missing declarations:
  - `create-in-repo-scaffold-typechecks`: TS7016
  - `published-subpath-console.pin`: TS7016, ENOENT on `dist/console.d.ts`
  - `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`: TS7016, ENOENT on `dist/hook-body.d.ts`
  - `scaffold-emission-typechecks`: TS7016 / TS2307
  - `scaffold-test-script-passes`: TS7016
- No new reader was found.
- Control leg, the same tree rebuilt with declarations (243 `.d.ts`), running `OS_TEST_SHARD=1/4`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 129 passed | 1 skipped (130)`, `Tests 1750 passed | 2 skipped`. The 5 readers ran there green, 56/56 tests.
</details>

<details><summary>Slice map, from vitest's own context on the real config</summary>

`createVitest` + `globTestSpecifications()` + `config.sequence.sequencer` against `BaseSequencer`, for `OS_TEST_SHARD=k/4`:

| | files per slice | readers per slice |
|---|---|---|
| before (`BaseSequencer`) | 130/130/130/130 | 2/1/1/1 |
| after (`DeclarationReaderSequencer`) | 130/130/130/130 | 5/0/0/0 |

- 520 files in the union, 0 duplicated, 9 files changed slice.
- The 1/4 run above executed exactly the after-map's slice 1 (130/130 files match).
- Summed per-file seconds per slice (from the runs above): before 301/602/833/401, after 313/595/827/401.
- The readers sum to 47 s in the DTS run, and they land on the lightest slice.
</details>

<details><summary>Placement and wall model, full `turbo ls` list (129 packages, dogfood excluded)</summary>

| shard | before (main) | after |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1502 s whole | cli 1/4 + metadata (143 s whole), **declarations** |
| 2 | 1502 s whole | 1598 s whole |
| 3 | 818 s whole + cli 1/4, **declarations** | 1598 s whole |
| 4 | 828 s whole + cli 2/4, **declarations** | 925 s whole + cli 2/4 |
| 5 | 826 s whole + cli 3/4, **declarations** | 926 s whole + cli 3/4 |
| 6 | 827 s whole + cli 4/4, **declarations** | 924 s whole + cli 4/4 |
| 7 | 1502 s whole incl. metadata, **declarations** | 1591 s whole |
| 8 | 1501 s whole | 1600 s whole |

- Shards building declarations: 5 before, 1 after.
- Wall model: step = whole/2.9 + slice, plus the closure (270 s with declarations, about 45–90 s without), plus about 90 s of setup.
  - Before, the slowest shard is about 22.0 min. CI read 23.9–25.4 min, so the model reads about 2 min low.
  - After, the slowest shard is about 18.8 min (shards 4–6), and shard 1 is about 18.1 min.
- Expected in CI: about 20–21 min.
- Every whole leg stays within the 1868 s cap. objectql and plugin-security stay apart.
</details>

<details><summary>Partitioner self-test and ablations</summary>

- `node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`: `self-test OK (75 measured packages -> 78 shard items, 8 shards, max/mean 1.00x ..., whole legs 143/1597/1597/925/924/923/1599/1597s within 1868s, file-level slices: @objectstack/cli x4)`.
- Ablation of the rider fix, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`:
  - The anchor went from 1 hit to 0 and the blob from 9e282f42e9d3 to 042fd9beb508.
  - The self-test then exited 1 with `the cap repair moved the whole reader off the reader slice's shard`.
  - Restore: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Inherited assertions, re-run here at `c5a59dfe5f`. Each went through `ablation-replace.mjs` with the anchor going 1 to 0, and each was restored to blob == HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`:
  - closure wall 270 to 0: exit 1, `cli 1/4's shard carries 826s of whole packages against [826, 827, 826]s ... not 300s less`;
  - rider placed in the next bin: exit 1, `@objectstack/metadata is on shard 2, not with @objectstack/cli 1/4 on shard 1`;
  - ci.yml `DTS_READER_SLICE='2'`: exit 1, `DECLARATION_READER_SLICES says slice 1, ci.yml DTS_READER_SLICE says 2`;
  - sequencer removed from the cli config: exit 1, `its vitest config does not install DeclarationReaderSequencer`;
  - reader dropped from `DECLARATION_READER_FILES` (slice map re-read through vitest's context): `scaffold-test-script-passes` moves to slice 2/4, a declaration-less slice, where the run above shows it red with TS7016. My first attempt at this one was refused by the tool, because the replacement text was not unique. It was restored, and the second attempt used a unique marker.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Acceptance is NOT MEASURED here:** the card asks for the slowest Test Core shard ≤ ~20 min on 3 consecutive spec-touching `pull_request` runs. That can only be read on this PR in CI. After landing, the ruling repeats the 10-full-queue-build reading of 6430866969 before the card closes, so this PR says `Part of`, not `Fixes`.
- Real slices are not equal-weight. The summed per-file seconds above make cli 3/4 the heaviest slice, which is the same slice as the slowest shard on main (5/8). This PR removes that shard's closure. It does not rebalance the slices (option C, not ruled).
- The partitioner's per-shard "Ns predicted" bin totals now include the reader slice's 783 s packing charge (closure, never test weight). `driftReport()` reads per-package timings, not bin totals, so the drift verdict is unaffected.
- Changeset: `skip-changeset`. `@objectstack/cli` ships `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`. `DeclarationReaderSequencer` / `DECLARATION_READER_FILES` have 0 hits under those paths, and the positive control (`hook-body` under `dist/`) hits. `scripts/` and `.github/` are not published.

- **Contract review (seat, before this PR opened):** card comment 6458259422, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, PASS on `c5a59dfe5f`, no must-fix. Its two should-fix notes:
  - **S2, the one hole this design cannot see:** a NEW declaration-reading cli test that nobody adds to `DECLARATION_READER_FILES` passes as long as vitest's sha1 cut happens to put it in slice 1 (about one chance in four). A later population change that moves the cut then reds an unrelated PR. That red means "add the file to `DECLARATION_READER_FILES`", not a flake. A listed reader that is renamed or deleted already refuses the config at load.
  - **S1:** the shard log's `Ns predicted (all bins: ...)` line and `balanceOf()` now include the reader slice's 783 s packing charge without saying so. `driftReport()` is untouched, so no verdict changes. The wording fix rides a follow-up.

## Verification

Final head `c5a59dfe5f`. It is a clean merge of `origin/main` that includes #26854 and the #25452 cache steps, in regions disjoint from this diff. `packages/cli` is unchanged across both merges. The reader and slice readings above were taken at `9d1cfdbf63`, which is merge base `912076f885` plus this diff.

<details><summary>Derived gates at c5a59dfe5f</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 86 families. All 86 exited 0, each exit captured before any pipe.
- `--ran` reported: `86 derived, 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a derived zero: all 86 recorded an exit code).
- On the earlier head `849642eb8c`, `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 1 and 3. That run overlapped my own rebuild of the closure, which had `tsup` cleaning dists. Re-run on the settled tree, both exited 0: `233/233 declared declaration file(s) present` and `112 published require entry point(s) across 69 package(s) load`. Both are 0 again on the final head.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`, which compiles `vitest.config.ts` through `tsconfig.test.json`, gave `VERDICT command-exit 0` and `check:test-typecheck: OK`. A first run went red in `../objectql/src/picklist-resolution.ts` because `metadata-core`'s dist was stale after the merge. It went green after rebuilding the closure.
- The ci.yml step's shell was exercised on 6 shard-file fixtures:
  - `cli 1/4` + metadata, `cli` whole, and `metadata` alone keep declarations;
  - `cli 2/4` + metadata-core, client-react + `cli 4/4`, and `cli 11/12` set `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`.
- Not measured:
  - actionlint and shellcheck: no binary in this container;
  - CI check-runs: no PR yet, because the contract review comes first;
  - the card's acceptance (≤ ~20 min on 3 spec-touching runs): CI-only;
  - slices 2–4/4 were not re-run as slices (declared narrowing). The whole-suite no-declarations run covers every one of their files green, and the slice map shows they hold no reader.
</details>
